sonic_characteristics.clean: Audiophile reference quality, Transparent and uncolored, Full dynamic range.
sonic_characteristics.glossy: Hyper-compressed, Autotune polish, Bright high-end, Digital precision.
sonic_characteristics.gritty: Tube saturation, Vinyl crackle, Room bleed, Tape hiss, Mid-range focus.
sonic_characteristics.brutal: Scooped mids, Gated drums, High-gain distortion, Aggressive transient shaping.
sonic_characteristics.ethereal: Massive hall reverb, Shimmer delay, Washed-out transients, Floating atmosphere.
sonic_characteristics.cyber: Bitcrushed textures, Glitch artifacts, Granular synthesis, Robotic vocal chains.
sonic_characteristics.warm: Analog warmth, Round bass, Smooth treble roll-off, Ribbon microphone character.
sonic_characteristics.kinetic: Transient heavy, Sidechain pumping, Dry percussion, Tight rhythmic pocket.
sonic_characteristics.abyssal: Sub-bass pressure, cavernous reverb, Low-pass filtering, Slow movement.

genre_fusion_recipes.Thall: Djent + Ambience + Dissonance: Pitch-shifted delays, bending guitars.
genre_fusion_recipes.Trap Metal: Trap 808s + Screaming Vocals: Distortion, simple flow, clipped bass.
genre_fusion_recipes.Glitchcore: Pop Melodies + IDM Glitches: Sped up vocals, bitcrushing, bubblegum synths.
genre_fusion_recipes.Dungeon Synth: Black Metal Atmosphere + Lo-Fi Synths: Medieval scales, low fidelity.
genre_fusion_recipes.Blackgaze: Black Metal Blast Beats + Shoegaze Wall of Sound: Tremolo picking, major key melodies.
genre_fusion_recipes.Phonk: Memphis Rap Vocals + Cowbells + Trap Beats: Sidechain compression, lo-fi grit.
genre_fusion_recipes.Hyperpop: Pop Melodies + Industrial Noise: Extreme autotune, pitched vocals, chaotic structure.
genre_fusion_recipes.Djent/Metalcore: Technical precision + Emotional dynamics: Polyrhythms, breakdowns, clean/scream contrast.
genre_fusion_recipes.Industrial Metal: Mechanical rhythms + Heavy guitars: Synth layers, distorted vocals, dystopian atmosphere.
genre_fusion_recipes.Deathcore: Death Metal brutality + Hardcore breakdowns: Guttural vocals, blast beats, crushing heaviness.
